'''Lake Vis''' was a deep body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harte Secur]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was an abundant source of [[Gooberfish/Legends|gooberfish]] and was also inhabited by the predatory [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]] and [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]]. The lake shared its name with [[Vis/Legends|Vis]], another Naboo city. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the company [[Capture of Harte Secur|captured]] Harte Secur and gathered [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from Lake Vis using [[utility trawler]]s. When the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] under [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] planned to [[Liberation of Harte Secur|liberate]] Harte Secur, they built a [[Unidentified Gungan camp (Harte Secur)|camp]] west of Lake Vis.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lake Vis appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' in the sixth level of the Gungan campaign, entitled "The Liberation of Harte Secur." It was identified in the level's reconnaissance report.<ref name="GB" />
